attributes.projectDescription:
Created for the NH - UNBC Climate & Health Knowledge Exchange Event on 12 April 2024.

This event is an opportunity for Northern Health staff and UNBC researchers interested in climate change to come together to: learn about existing work, tap into northern BC expertise, leverage resources and identify synergies.

Climate change variables (Days >30°C and seasonal precipitation) are from the CMIP6 (CanDCS-U6) dataset, emissions scenario SSP585, downloaded from ClimateData.ca.
